deploy-bot: Postdeploy quickchecks for release v1.12.7 -> prod-usw1 complete. Summary: small error bump on /v1/chat (0.03% -> 0.12%), p99 increased by 220ms. Starting 15m monitoring.
Naveen: I see a few TLS handshake timeouts to model-hosts during the deploy window.
Priya: errors look like transient 502 from sidecar, but no core service 5xx.
Oncall-Alex: recommend enabling synthetic retry fallback (local cache) for chat-route while we observe. low-risk toggle.
Naveen: toggling feature flag: `ffctl set chat_local_retry true --env=prod`
Priya: enabling now. deploy-bot: FF update executed by Naveen at 2932104602.
Naveen: after toggling, error rate back to 0.04% and p99 down to +80ms.
Oncall-Alex: good stopgap. open INF-4756 for sidecar TLS race when scaling new pods. tag networking-team.
release-cop: noting in release notes: "v1.12.7: minor chat p99 regression mitigated by enabling local retry fallback. Investigating sidecar TLS handshake races."
Priya: will follow up with sidecar team and provide traces.
Naveen: leaving feature flag on for next 24h. will revert if no further regressions.
release-cop: closing thread as monitoring.
